scope: New single-original source-readiness audit of an existing exposed trial. No cohort expansion, outcome labeling, efficacy inference or new predictor bundle.
version_rule: Only exact Prot_SAP_002.pdf selected from retained same-NCT API bytes. ICF001/ICF003 and other protocol versions remain distinct. No fresh API lookup or automatic version substitution.
new_source_sealing: No prior expected original hash exists. Verify fixed URL/size/PDF signature and lineage, then seal newly observed body SHA. A positive-control hash match is not claimed.

extraction.installation: Existing isolated research tooling, not a runtime dependency
extraction.physical_page_numbers: One-based PDF page indices, separate from printed pagination
extraction.truncation: None; unreadable formulas/tables held explicitly, not inferred

review_axes: Exact trial/title/protocol identifier and investigator/sponsor linkage
Cover/version/amendment/approval timeline and whether SAP is actually present
Experimental regimen, comparator, population, phase and relation to frozen origin scope
Primary endpoint definition, assessment time and unit of inference
Primary comparison/estimand, analysis population and statistical test/model
Missing data, intercurrent events, protocol deviations and sensitivity analyses
Interim/final designated analysis and actual trial-level success/failure rule
Sample-size assumptions versus observed decision or clinical outcomes
Evidence version existed before analysis/unblinding, separately from internal dates
Historical public availability by2026-04-01, separately from present-day download/upload metadata
Unresolved scope, date/version conflicts, missing appendices and independent truth limitations
review_design: Two AI reviewers read source PDF/all-page extraction and frozen origin scope independently; do not read the other current review before both seal. Technical verifier checks original-page locators, hashes and extraction. Root reconciles all axes and retains disagreements; AI agreement is not independent scientific truth.
per_review_required: Each axis disposition with exact physical-page/section locators
Distinguish explicit statement, reasonable interpretation and unknown
Do not infer absent provisions from a keyword-only search
Identify rule completeness without assigning an efficacy outcome
Keep total verbatim excerpts below50words; paraphrase with page locators
historical_rules: Internal protocol date, current API uploadDate, server Last-Modified or later download do not alone qualify historical public availability or authentic prespecification. Evaluate each separately; missing proof remains held.
completion: One retained original or explicit terminal failure, sealed all-page extraction, two independent source reviews, original-source verification and scientific disposition. Failed retrieval stops scientific review without replacement; no retry.
next_boundary: A completed rule/source audit cannot amend prior labels, activate source-readiness cohort, train/scoring, interpret patient outcomes or change chronology. Any further historical-version/result access requires another explicit frozen request.
